scope: paired Vanilla and Mutation-Guided test-suite preparation for the 36 sanitized C1 source packages; no later-checkpoint execution

model.decoding_note: Use the Codex service default; the CLI does not expose a temperature override.

budget.candidate_unit: candidate files; each file may define exactly one top-level pytest test function
budget.attempt_policy: At most three launched calls total per method and checkpoint: one generation call and up to two retries only if the Codex process fails before capturing structured output. A completed response, including an empty test list, is not retried.
budget.token_usage_policy: Record service-reported usage when available. If unavailable, store null and report the limitation; do not make token-count claims. The call and eight-candidate caps remain binding.

validation.flakiness_rule: Reject a candidate if collection or any execution run fails, times out, is unstable, or introduces a failure beyond the stable C1 baseline.
validation.correctness_rule: Retain only candidates whose asserted behavior is directly specified and has an independently documented correctness rationale. No reference implementation is assumed.
validation.base_suite_rule: Preserve the complete sanitized package base suite unchanged. When it has stable C1 failures, record those failures and require each generated candidate to pass without introducing additional failures.
validation.guided_rule: Each retained Guided candidate must kill at least one declared eligible same-checkpoint surviving mutant when run with the stable passing C1 tests plus that candidate.

data_policy.hidden_and_future_data: never supplied to generation, mutation triage, or validation
data_policy.file_backup_errors: excluded and isolated under data/excluded_tests per the sanitized isolation manifest
data_policy.trajectory_provenance: Release snapshots and per-checkpoint agent_run_manifest.json are accepted as the supplied frozen C1 trajectory evidence; raw conversation transcripts are not present in the Release
